items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to unipolar vs bipolar depression, ICD-10 diagnostic criteria, and biological and psychological theories of depression.

items.title: All in the Mind — BBC Radio 4
items.description: Claudia Hammond's BBC Radio 4 programme regularly explores the science and experience of depression, including episodes on diagnosis, biology, and psychological theories.

items.title: Depressive and Bipolar Disorders: Crash Course Psychology #30
items.description: Crash Course episode covering the characteristics of unipolar and bipolar depression, how they are diagnosed, and the biological and psychological explanations — closely matches the AQA spec.

items.title: What is depression? — Helen M. Farrell (TED-Ed)
items.description: Clear animated TED-Ed explanation of the symptoms, causes, and prevalence of depression, covering both biological and cognitive perspectives.

items.title: The Science of Depression — AsapSCIENCE
items.description: Visual explainer of the neurochemical and biological basis of depression, covering serotonin, noradrenaline, and the role of stress — links directly to the biological theory on the spec.

items.title: I had a black dog, his name was depression — WHO
items.description: WHO animated short based on Matthew Johnstone's book — illustrates the emotional and behavioural characteristics of depression in a way that builds empathy and understanding.

items.title: Simply Psychology — Psychological Theories of Depression
items.description: Concise revision notes covering the biological, behavioural, and cognitive theories of depression — well matched to the AQA GCSE specification.

items.title: Mind — Understanding Depression
items.description: Mind charity's accessible guide to depression, covering types, symptoms, and causes — useful for understanding the real-world picture alongside the theory.
